note: Art origins, best first. The client prefixes the art manifests' image/Spine URLs with the first source that answers (/asset-mirrors.json is its probe) and falls back to the game server — see docs/ASSETS.md. `http://123.57.150.185` is the owner's own relay (Aliyun Beijing, 200 Mbps, nginx over a clone of this repository's public/) and is listed in `fullSources` because it ALSO reimplements the game's extension-less routes (/media audio, /scene battlefield bundles, /clip boot video): with it installed the client sends those classes to the relay too. The two free CDN mirrors below serve plain files only (no /media, /scene or /clip) and github raw is often unreachable from mainland China — they stay as plain-file fallbacks. Update the owner/repo in the CDN entries if the repository moves. Traffic on the relay is unmetered (owner, 2026-10-14).
